_comment: CANDIDATE ONLY — NOT DEPLOYED, AND NOT REFERENCED BY firebase.json.
MAP Phase 5 (P5-E). This file exists because the repository declares NO
Firestore composite index anywhere: firebase.json has no `indexes` key and
no firestore.indexes.json exists. That was harmless until Phase 5, because
every other query in the app is equality-only and Firestore serves those
without a declared composite index. The Note Foundation introduced the
first three queries that combine equality filters with an orderBy on a
different field, and each one of those requires a composite index or fails
in production with `failed-precondition: The query requires an index`.
The Firestore EMULATOR does not enforce this — proven by
even when started with an index file declaring zero indexes. So no passing
emulator suite says anything at all about index requirements.
Deploying indexes is an Owner Control Gate, like Rules.

indexes._query: note-foundation.js listNotesForOwner() — a person's own Notes, newest first
note-foundation.js listNoteRevisions() — one Note's revision history, newest first
note-foundation.js listNoteSourcesForUnit() — ADR-009's read side, newest first
